project.title: Cross-Channel Customer Feedback Improvement Pilot
project.objective: Design and run a 6-week pilot to capture, route, and act on customer feedback across digital, support, and membership channels.
deliverables: End-to-end customer feedback process map and RACI
Unified feedback taxonomy and routing rules
Pilot feedback dashboard with key KPIs
Updated help desk and membership response scripts
Customer communication plan for the pilot
Pilot evaluation report with improvement roadmap
constraints: Pilot must run using existing core systems and tools
All data handling must comply with data protection and privacy rules
No changes to contractual insurance terms or coverage
Minimal disruption to vineyard cellar operations during peak hours
Limited budget for new software; focus on configuration and process
Deadline to complete pilot and report within 30 days

risks.risk: Low adoption of new feedback process by frontline staff.
risks.mitigation: Provide short training, clear scripts, and quick reference guides; collect early feedback and adjust.

risks.risk: Data privacy issues when consolidating customer feedback.
risks.mitigation: Involve data protection officer, anonymise data where possible, and document handling rules.

risks.risk: Technical limitations of existing systems to tag and route feedback.
risks.mitigation: Use simple tagging conventions, shared sheets, and manual routing as interim workaround.

risks.risk: Inconsistent handling of complaints across membership, help desk, and insurance teams.
risks.mitigation: Agree shared taxonomy, escalation rules, and standard response templates before pilot start.

risks.risk: Operational overload during vineyard peak production days.
risks.mitigation: Limit vineyard-related feedback collection to predefined time windows and simple checklists.

themes.why_relevant: Needed to classify feedback consistently across help desk, membership, insurance, and visits.
Feedback contains personal data; all teams must align with protection and retention rules.
Feedback must reach the right team with clear response times and escalation paths.
New process must fit into daily routines of help desk, membership, insurance, and cellar staff.
BI needs clear metrics to evaluate pilot success and propose long-term improvements.

backlog.task: Map current customer feedback touchpoints and channels across teams
definition_of_done: List of all digital, phone, in-person, and written feedback channels documented
Owners and systems for each touchpoint identified
Gaps and overlaps in current coverage highlighted in the process map

backlog.task: Define unified feedback categories and tagging rules
definition_of_done: Feedback taxonomy with 10–20 categories agreed by all stakeholders
Tagging examples documented for typical cases
Taxonomy shared in a reference guideline and approved by project sponsor

backlog.task: Design help desk intake script for capturing structured feedback
definition_of_done: Script covers greeting, consent, data privacy notice, and key questions
Script tested on at least 5 recent ticket scenarios
Feedback from BI and membership roles incorporated and script versioned

backlog.task: Create membership team process for proactive feedback collection
definition_of_done: Short survey or question set defined for member interactions
Process for logging and tagging member feedback documented
Alignment with BI on how data will be shared and reported

backlog.task: Set up simple feedback dashboard for pilot KPIs
definition_of_done: Dashboard shows volume, category mix, and resolution times
Data sources and refresh frequency documented
At least one test dataset loaded and validated with stakeholders

backlog.task: Define cellar visit feedback checklist for on-site visitors
definition_of_done: Checklist covers visit experience, safety, and product feedback
Format is easy to use on paper or tablet during tours
Process for handing completed checklists to BI agreed

backlog.task: Align insurance-related complaint handling with new taxonomy
definition_of_done: Mapping between existing insurance complaint codes and new taxonomy completed
Standard responses and escalation rules documented
At least 10 historical complaints reclassified as a test

backlog.task: Draft customer-facing communication about the feedback pilot
definition_of_done: Short message explaining purpose and channels of the pilot written
Data privacy statement reviewed by BI and compliance
Message approved for use on website, email, and on-site signage

backlog.task: Document data protection and access rules for feedback data
definition_of_done: List of who can access which feedback data created
Retention periods and anonymisation rules documented
Guideline reviewed by BI and insurance roles for compliance

backlog.task: Train frontline staff on new feedback process and scripts
definition_of_done: Short training session plan and materials prepared
At least one session held with each involved team
Attendance and key questions captured for follow-up

backlog.task: Run pilot and collect issues and improvement ideas
definition_of_done: Pilot runs for agreed duration with daily data capture
List of process and system issues logged
Preliminary improvement ideas summarised for review

backlog.task: Prepare final pilot evaluation and recommendations
definition_of_done: Pilot results analysed against KPIs
Recommendations prioritised by impact and effort
Final report shared with all stakeholders before deadline

artifacts.title: Cellar Visit Feedback Checklist

artifacts.title: Help Desk and Membership Response Scripts
artifacts.used_for: Standard scripts for capturing feedback and informing customers about data use.

artifacts.title: Pilot Feedback Log and Routing Register
artifacts.used_for: Shared log to track incoming feedback, tags, owners, and resolution status.

artifacts.title: Pilot Evaluation Report and Roadmap
artifacts.used_for: Summarises pilot outcomes and recommended next steps for long-term rollout.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, touchpoints, and overall pilot plan.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the cross-team customer feedback pilot.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm which customer touchpoints are in scope for the pilot.
Agree on the 30-day pilot timeline and key milestones.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and finalise the unified feedback taxonomy and routing rules.
threads_plan.trigger: BI manager shares first draft of feedback categories and asks for input.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final list of feedback categories and tags.
Agree routing rules for membership, help desk, insurance, and cellar feedback.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on frontline scripts, checklists, and training approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Help desk agent posts draft scripts and asks for operational feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on help desk and membership scripts for pilot use.
Confirm cellar checklist format and when it will be used during visits.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Set up KPI tracking, data protection rules, and dashboard expectations.
threads_plan.trigger: BI manager shares draft KPI list and data handling proposal.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on core KPIs to track during the pilot.
Approve data protection and access rules for feedback data.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results and agree on next steps and roadmap.
threads_plan.trigger: BI manager posts preliminary pilot results and asks for reactions.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide whether to extend, scale, or stop the pilot after evaluation.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in where each role posts yesterday's feedback volume and any blockers.
Twice-weekly 15-minute async review of new feedback patterns and routing issues.
Weekly KPI snapshot post from BI with short commentary and questions.
End-of-pilot retrospective thread to capture lessons learned and process tweaks.
